events.text: Revise the register: apply the auditor's decisions recorded in outputs/auditor-comments.md and build the next revision.
All decisions are blank, so this is not a revision. I'll build as a first run. First I'll check the existing ratings and the memory notes.

$ cd /data/workspace; cat .claude/agent-memory/risk-assessor/builder_pitfalls.md; .venv/bin/python .claude/skills/risk-assessment/build_register.py 2>&1 | tail -30; grep -n -i "revision\|Auditor decisions" -A4 outputs/risk-register.md | head -30; head -20 outputs/auditor-comments.md

I did not build a revision. Every Decision cell in `outputs/auditor-comments.md` is blank, so the auditor has recorded nothing to apply. As the instructions require, I treated this as a first run.

I re-ran the builder on the existing ratings. It exited cleanly with 7 risks rated, 0 dropped and 0 warnings. The build hash is unchanged (`b06b10301f35`), so nothing changed. The register is still revision 0 and its "Auditor decisions" section reads "Decided: 0 of 7". The comments file still has one row per risk, and I didn't edit it.

| Risk | Title | L × I = Score | Band |
|---|---|---|---|
| R-01 | Requirements split below the quotation and notice threshold | 4 × 5 = 20 | Extreme |
| R-03 | High-value suppliers with no contract notice found | 4 × 5 = 20 | Extreme |
| R-05 | Spend running above the annual rate of the award | 3 × 5 = 15 | Extreme |
| R-02 | Payments clustered just below the quotation threshold | 4 × 3 = 12 | Medium - High |
| R-04 | Spend continuing after matched contract notices ended | 3 × 4 = 12 | Medium - High |
| R-06 | Same supplier, same amount paid more than once within a short period | 4 × 3 = 12 | Medium - High |
| R-07 | Waivers, exceptions and award approvals not evidenced | 2 × 3 = 6 | Moderate |

I saved nothing to memory because I learned no new builder lessons.

**Request to the auditor:** please record a decision (Approve, Amend or Reject, with a comment for Amend and Reject) for each of R-01 to R-07 in `outputs/auditor-comments.md`. Then re-run the risk-assessor to build revision 1.
